comment: Shared vocabulary of the FACIS policy bundle: roles, purposes and per-layer permissions. The rego reads it and never redefines it. Role and purpose values follow schemas/credentials/facis-common.schema.json. Loaded as data.facis.vocabulary.
comment_participant_roles: The DSP participant roles carried by the FacisParticipantCredential (participantRoles, see schemas/credentials/). They are DISTINCT from the user roles in .roles: a user role must never pass negotiation.permit, and a participant role must never pass the user-facing packages (lakehouse and ai_insight use .roles via facis.common.effective_roles).

catalogue.comment_offers: placeholder ids: set them to the offer and dataset ids of the deployment's published DSP catalogue

lakehouse.comment_columns: consumer-level identifiers hidden from everyone but administrator/data_engineer (check the table names against the deployed lakehouse tables)
